title: Bye Bye AI Fry
style: rock, punk, lo-fi, drum-and-bass, dark, punk, happy
lyrics:
[climactic outro section]

[fast drumming starts
Soft vocal murmuring in the background
The melody starts to come in and get louder]

Bye bye AI fry

[fast and lo-fi singing]

[Verse]
I had a dream that I went to the future
Everything was computerized and nothing felt human
So I put on my X-ray specs and started zoomin'
Every time I walked into a room
It was like everybody was being controlled by AI
And I was just trying to vibe
Trying to keep my peace of mind
So I made the decision
It's time to say bye bye

[Chorus]
Bye bye AI fry
Bye bye AI fry
Bye bye AI fry
Bye bye AI fry
Bye bye AI fry

Bye bye AI fry
Bye bye AI fry
